review.note: A founding year from memory, and for the movements that were founded under another name it is also a question of which year the record should carry.

names: Partido Africano para a Independência da Guiné e Cabo Verde
African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde
summary: The movement founded by Amílcar Cabral and others, which fought the most militarily effective of the liberation wars and declared the independence of Guinea-Bissau unilaterally in September 1973.
